hesa_enrollment.description: Total non-UK domicile students enrolled in UK higher education institutions
hesa_enrollment.note: Academic years shown as ending year (e.g. 2016 = 2015/16). 2015/16 and 2016/17 estimated from HESA trend data.
hesa_enrollment.notes_2024: First decline in a decade: -3.5% overall, -7% for international. India -15%, China -4%, Nigeria -36%.

student_visas.source: Home Office Immigration System Statistics, year ending September 2025
student_visas.description: Sponsored study entry clearance visa grants (main applicants only)
student_visas.note: Calendar years. 2025 is partial (Q1-Q3). Pre-2018 figures from GOV.UK narrative: ~200k/yr 2011-2016, rising to 285k in 2019. Peak was 652k including dependants in YE June 2023.

graduate_route.source: Home Office Immigration System Statistics / Migration Observatory
graduate_route.description: Graduate Route visa extensions granted (main applicants + dependants where noted)
graduate_route.note: Graduate Route launched July 2021. Years are year-ending September. Top 4 nationalities (India, Nigeria, China, Pakistan) = 70% of all grants. Indian nationals = 46% of grants.
